excerpt.zh: 错误：无法确定一组无人机位置。该小组离开工作设施进行强制性维护，却在前往存储区的路上消失了。调查工作正在进行中。
excerpt.en: Error: unable to determine the location of a squad of drones. The group left the work facility for their mandatory maintenance round only to disappear on their way to the housing district. Investigative efforts are ongoing.

texts.zh: 错误：无法确定一组无人机位置。该小组离开工作设施进行强制性维护，却在前往存储区的路上消失了。调查工作正在进行中。
texts.en: Error: unable to determine the location of a squad of drones. The group left the work facility for their mandatory maintenance round only to disappear on their way to the housing district. Investigative efforts are ongoing.

texts.zh: 丢失/遗忘/弄丢我们中的一部分。具体而言：一整个人口单元。如果找到，请归还到[Root.Owner.GetName]
texts.en: Lost / forgot / misplaced multiple parts of ourselves. To be exact: an entire population unit. If found, please return to the [Root.Owner.GetName]

texts.zh: 空舞台……沉默？演员失踪？意外损失。困惑
texts.en: Empty stage... Silence? Actors missing! Unplanned loss. Confusion.

texts.zh: 情况更新：失踪无人机小队的位置已确认。这些机器被发现站在田野上，尽管已经启动，但他们一动不动没有任何反应。初步分析证实，他们的内存驱动器已被磁爆擦除。
texts.en: Update: location of missing drone squad confirmed. The machines were found standing on a field, unmoving and unresponsive despite being switched on. Preliminary analysis confirms their memory drives were wiped by a magnetic burst.

texts.zh: 情况更新：找到失踪躯体。无人机已启动，但无响应。睡着？站住。冻住。
texts.en: Update: found missing bodies. Drones appear to be switched on, yet unresponsive. Asleep?  Standing still. Frozen.

texts.zh: 拍手/高兴！发现玩具。但是弄丢。坏了。太好了！太好了！
texts.en: Clapping / rejoice! Toys discovered. But lost. Broken. No strings no strings.

texts.zh:
状态报告：丢失的无人机已成功重新激活并重新融入我们的工作队伍。

然而由于持续存在的硬件损坏，他们的功能表现明显下降。
texts.en:
Status report: the missing drones have been successfully reactivated and reintegrated within our workforce.

However, due to lingering hardware damage, their performance functionality has noticeably decreased.

texts.zh: 失踪自我重装/苏醒/激活。但是：认知清晰度下降。宇宙浑浊。
texts.en: Misplaced selves rebooted / awakened / reactivated. However: cognitive clarity decreased. The universe is murky.

texts.zh: 人偶缝合。觉醒！跳……摔倒……尖叫。叹息。抱怨。
texts.en: Doll stitches. Awakening! Jump... fall... scream. Sigh. Lament.

texts.zh:
状态报告：丢失的无人机已成功重新激活并重新融入我们的工作队伍。

作为一个意想不到的好处，纯净的重新安装出乎意料地提高了他们的性能。
texts.en:
Status report: the missing drones have been successfully reactivated and reintegrated within our workforce.

As an unintended bonus, the clean reinstall unexpectedly improved their performance.

texts.zh: 失踪自我重装/苏醒/激活。认知清晰度上升。宇宙亮晶晶。
texts.en: Misplaced selves rebooted / awakened / reactivated. Cognitive clarity increased. The universe is crystalline.

texts.zh: 人偶缝合。觉醒！跳……华尔兹……呜呜。欢呼。鼓掌鼓掌鼓掌。
texts.en: Doll stitches. Awakening! Jump... waltz... awe. Applause. Clapclapclap.
